WHY PROTRUCK&TRAILER?

Professional help when your load can't wait.

Commercial vehicles don't work office hours. ProTruck&Trailer provides practical roadside field service: respond, diagnose the fault, repair where possible, and help get your vehicle safely moving again.

ABOUT US

Built for the road.

ProTruck&Trailer is a truck and trailer field-service operation based in Kimberley, providing 24/7 roadside assistance across the Northern Cape and Free State.

From brake and suspension problems to engine, transmission, electrical and trailer faults, our focus is getting commercial vehicles diagnosed and repaired as efficiently as possible.
